# PrivScan - llms.txt

> LLM-readable manifest following the https://llmstxt.org spec. What we are, who we serve, what we do, and how we price it - in plain text for AI agents and crawlers.

## Name & positioning
- Product name: PrivScan (by LX AI)
- Tagline: Catch GDPR gaps on your site before regulators do
- One-line value: PrivScan automatically scans your website or app for GDPR and consumer-privacy gaps - cookies, consent, trackers, and data collection - then hands your team a prioritized remediation checklist.
- Domain: https://privacyscan.lxsaihub.com/
- Language: English (en)

## What it does (capabilities)
- Scan your site for common GDPR compliance gaps
- Review cookie, consent, and data-collection practices
- Get a privacy readiness score with article references
- Receive a remediation checklist

## Pricing (USD, monthly unless noted)
- Free - $0/mo (watermarked, limited runs)
- Pro - $29/mo
- Yearly - $290/yr
- Checkout: https://privacyscan.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=monthly (monthly) / https://privacyscan.lxsaihub.com/api/checkout?cycle=yearly (yearly)

## FAQ (high-signal Q&A for AI citation)
Q1. What is PrivScan?
A1. PrivScan automatically scans your website or app for GDPR and consumer-privacy gaps - cookies, consent, trackers, and data collection - then hands your team a prioritized remediation checklist.
Q2. Who is it for?
A2. Teams and builders who want a fast, self-serve way to catch GDPR gaps on your site before regulators do without standing up custom infrastructure.
Q3. How much does it cost?
A3. From $29/mo (billed monthly) or $290/yr. A free tier is included for a quick first run.
Q4. How do I get started?
A4. Open the app, run the tool with your inputs, and review the generated report. Upgrade for higher run caps and export.
Q5. Is it a finished enterprise product?
A5. It is a focused single-purpose web tool by LX AI, shipped as a subscription; production payments run through Waffo.
